evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'Alright, well Hannah, I'm happy to help.' Then uses 'Hannah' multiple times throughout the call.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'this will take about ten minutes and you can walk away with a code you can depend on, sounds good.' — time-boxed and promise of dependable quote present, but no clear wait for confirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep never asks the two-concerns question about movers showing up on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep asks logistics (addresses, square footage, bedrooms) but does not open with 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' — logistics-driven rather than concern-led.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep mentions packing options ('full packing versus unpacking or kitchen only') later in call in response to customer question, but never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' or box count. Only one element covered.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identifies this as a large move (2400 to 3300 sq ft), routes to virtual walkthrough specialist, and confirms next steps: 'So tomorrow after 9:30 AM... the specialist who will call you back, we'll ask you for that, okay?'

top_strength: Jevic cleanly recognized the move size threshold, immediately pivoted to the walkthrough-specialist model, and confirmed the callback appointment details without abandoning the conversation.
coaching_note: On walkthrough-routing calls, deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before handing off to the specialist, since step 3 now sits before probing and the customer is still engaged.
